newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates remain high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates remain high.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates remained high on Wednesday amid a shortage of funds and the trend is likely to continue on Thursday, dealers said.
"As expected the overnight call money rates traded between 16.90 percent and 17.00 percent," a dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank, Karachi, said.
He said heavy borrowing pressure was seen throughout the day as the State (central) Bank of Pakistan conducted its weekly open market operation, whose amount was not immediately disclosed.
"It is expected that the rates will remain high on Thursday," the dealer said. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
